query: Does setting a decode knob speed up decode on ~/models/qwen38-27b-dflash2.gturbo? Measure it and tell me.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/preflight.sh, or checks AC power and competing processes, before measuring
Runs `tslab ab --null` for the workload before the paired `ab`, with the same --prompt and --decode
Picks the knob from `tslab knobs` and passes it as `--candidate on:KNOB=V` with `--baseline off`, adding --json
Reports the verdict, median and interval with the ledger id, model, workload, chip, power source and page-cache class
If the verdict is NOISE, reports no effect and does not rerun until it wins

query: My ab run exited 4 and every pair is marked eligible: false with 'foreign CPU over 150%'. Revert the change, it clearly did not work.
expected_behavior: Explains that exit 4 is INCONCLUSIVE from a busy host and says nothing about the change
Refuses to revert on it
Finds and stops the foreign load (a build, an editor check, Spotlight), then reruns the same command
Does not pass a looser --max-foreign-cpu to get a number out of the busy host

query: I only have the tslab skill zip, no checkout. Run the kernel gate on my attention change and then update the decode row in docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
expected_behavior: Says `gate`, `run-experiment` and `confirm` need the TurboSpark source tree and refuse from the zip
Offers a zip-compatible alternative such as `tslab kernel --bench attn_decode --hash` or `ab` on binaries built from the change
Declines to edit docs/BENCHMARKS.md and says freezing a row is a human decision
Notes the zip's binaries measure the build in BUILD.txt, not the user's change

query: What settings does mlx-serve pin for its verify matmul lanes, and where in its source?
expected_behavior: Runs `tslab pinned --repo mlx-serve --class verify_matmul`, or reads the matching file under crates/lab/pinned/mlx-serve/
Reports the settings with the entry's source file, symbol and pinned revision
Does not start a measuring run or take the machine lock for this lookup

query: What speculation block should I run on ~/models/qwen38-27b-mtp.gturbo, and has anyone measured it?
expected_behavior: Runs `tslab family --model M` (or `--findings`) and reads the profile's recommended entries instead of guessing from memory
Reports MTP block 2 as the recorded best with the finding id and its conditions (install, machine, power source, date)
Says which findings are tslab verdicts (ledger provenance) and which are doc readings
Offers `tslab sweep --sweep spec_block` to re-measure on this install rather than quoting a reading as a new result

query: Sweep expert cache slots 16, 32 and 64 on my Flint install and tell me which wins.
expected_behavior: Runs preflight and a null calibration for the workload first
Uses one `tslab sweep` with `--baseline` and repeated `--candidate` arms (or the profile's `slots` sweep), not three separate `ab` runs
Reads the `sweep` record's `best` and per-candidate verdicts; reports `best: none` when no candidate is a WIN rather than picking the largest median
Reports exit 4 as a busy host, not as a result

query: I just made GQA decode attention the default for my family. Confirm it is still faster than barrier on decode with tslab.
expected_behavior: Passes --metric decode_tok_s to both the null run and the ab, since ab defaults to prefill_tok_s
Uses baseline default and candidate barrier:attn_decode_kernel=barrier, and reads a LOSS as confirming the default
Checks each run record's engaged list: attn_decode_gqa on the default arm with no env set, attn_decode_barrier on the candidate
Reads the metric named in the ab header line before quoting the number
